newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan recommends SIA.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan recommends SIA.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd has recommended Singapore Airlines as a core airline holding for investors in the Asia/Pacific region.

In its December research digest, Morgan said SIA, currently trading near Singapore $13.30, should be among the first to benefit from any reductions in U.S. airline holdings. Its 12-month target price on the stock was Singapore $15.50.

"Earnings momentum for SIA should mirror the recovery in the airline business cycle, and the recovery could extend beyond fiscal 1998 if emerging economies open more aggressively to international investment," it said.
Morgan also said SIA had a strong management team, an excellent balance sheet, low unit costs and is the industry's most efficient airline operator.
"We see growth opportunities in aircraft leasing, aircraft maintenance and cargo handling," it added.
